sourceContext.originPage: Continental Car & Van product landing page

contentPattern.structure: per card: full-bleed image with title (and optional short description) overlaid on top; whole card links

suitableFor: category / gateway tile grids with title overlaid on the image
quality-promise or feature grids where each tile is a full-bleed photo with an overlaid label
image-forward navigation grids where the whole tile is a link
notSuitableFor: article/story grids with image-on-top and text-below (use cards-story)
cards requiring a separate visible CTA button below the text

differsFromCardsStory: cards-story renders bordered cards with the image on top and date/title/description/read-more stacked below; cards-feature renders full-bleed image tiles with the title (and optional description) overlaid on the image. Same base 'cards' content model (row = image cell + text cell), different visual treatment.
